title: A Minecraft Movie
tagline: Baked potatoes, mushroom stew and a chook with a rider.
about: Four misfits are pulled through a portal into the blocky Overworld and need Steve's help to get home.
cue: Serve the drumsticks when the baby zombie rides a chook into the arena.
faces: Cook the chicken before dark, everyone. Zombies show up at night and they never bring a plate.

cheddar150g sour cream1 bunch chivesHeat the oven to 200°C.Prick the large potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake directly on the rack for 60 to 70 minutes until crisp outside and soft inside.Fry the diced bacon until crisp.Split the potatoes, fluff the insides with a fork and add the butter.Top with the grated cheddar and return to the oven for 5 minutes.Finish with bacon, the sour cream and chives.Melon block skewers with mint sugarMelon crafted block by blockHow to make itAs written, serves 4Watermelon, rockmelon and honeydew cut into perfect cubes, stacked onto skewers like blocks and sprinkled with lime and mint sugar.Cut a quarter of a watermelon, half a rockmelon and half a honeydew into neat 2.5cm cubes, trimming them square.Thread onto 12 skewers in alternating colours, or stack into little towers on a board.Pound 2 tbsp caster sugar with 6 mint leaves and the zest of 1 lime in a mortar until green.Squeeze lime juice over the melon and sprinkle with the mint sugar just before serving.Golden carrots with honey butterThe golden apples were already taken.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsSteve's honey drumsticksSticky roast drumsticks in honey, chilli flakes and smoked paprikaHow to make it12 chicken drumsticks4 tbsp honey1 tsp chilli flakes2 tsp smoked paprikaToss the chicken drumsticks with the honey, the chilli flakes, the smoked paprika, the oil and salt.Roast at 200°C for 45 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky and charred at the edges.Crafted mushroom stew with cheesy toastThe stew crafted from red and brown mushroomsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Mixed mushrooms browned in butter and simmered with onion, garlic, thyme, stock and cream until rich and thick, with cheesy garlic toast for dunking.Brown 800g mixed sliced mushrooms in batches in 40g butter over high heat.Remove.Soften 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves for 5 minutes, then stir in 1 tbsp plain flour and thyme.Add 500ml vegetable stock and the mushrooms and simmer 15 minutes.Stir in 150ml cream and season.Top 8 slices of baguette with garlic butter and 80g grated cheddar and grill until bubbling.Serve the stew in bowls with the shortcrust pastry200ml thickened creamRoast the pumpkin until soft and purée.Whisk with the condensed milk, the eggs, the cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg.Pour into a blind-baked shortcrust case and
